code_summary: No code for the daily summary report of returned court summonses. ocmsadminui only has 4 Court Reports menu entries (SHORTLISTING, COURTDESCAPP, SUMMON, REJECTED) with an empty path and a commented-out resource, no list component and no API. The daily reports in ocmsadminprivateapi (daily_reports) are only ANS letter reconciliation, classified vehicle and RIP hirer/driver.
note: Story status is blank (requirement not given), traced normally. Synonyms tried: summary report, daily summary, returned summons, address change, court report, courtcasesummary, dashboard, records checked/received, across all six repos (UI and API). Result: the ocmsadminui Report menu declares Court Application Vault / Submit / Summon / Rejected Reports (Report/index.tsx:61-76, action/ActionReport.tsx:36-64) but path is "" and the courtcasesummary resource endpoint is commented out; there is no ReportList component for those types and no courtcasesummary controller/authorization in the backend. No cron counts records checked, received or address change detected for returned summonses. CAS inbound endpoints are not credited. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-194 (Open) says new court reports are still to be created, which supports that they do not exist yet; it is not proof of code.
recommendation: Not claimed: the daily returned court summons report and its routing to the dashboard do not exist in code. Confirm whether it is built outside the six repos.

steps.step: OCMS checks the registered address for returned court summonses and counts records checked
steps.detail: No job or service checks the registered address of returned court summonses. ocms_court_case (OcmsCourtCase.java:18-32) has no check-result field or address change flag. The daily jobs in daily_reports are AnsLetterReconciliationJob, ClassifiedVehicleReportJob and RipHirerDriverReportJob; none touches court summonses. Cannot verify from repo whether the check happens in CAS.

steps.step: OCMS generates a daily summary report: records checked, received, and records with address change detected
steps.detail: No daily summary report generator for returned court summonses exists in ocmsadminprivateapi/ocmsadminapi (grep summary report, daily summary, courtcasesummary, address change). ocmsadminui only has court report configuration with a commented-out resource (ActionReport.tsx:36-64; the "courtcasesummary" endpoint does not exist in the backend). The three counts (checked, received, address change detected) are computed nowhere.

steps.step: The report is routed to the Court Processing Officer dashboard
steps.detail: Report/index.tsx:61-76 registers menu titles Court Application Vault/Submit, Court Summon and Court Rejected Reports with path "" so there is no page or route. There is no ReportList component for those types (the ReportList*.tsx files do not include them) and no automatic routing to a dashboard. Only menu titles, not a feature; not credited even though Sebagian is tempting.

steps.step: Officer downloads the summary report for reference
steps.detail: Download of the court reports cannot work: the resource in ActionReport.tsx:36-64 is commented out and no backend endpoint exists. A generic report download exists for other types (ReportList*), but it is not the report the story names; not credited.
